Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.A. No. 999/2019

Dear Ms. Sethi,

Thank you for meeting us on 13 December 2019 about your dispute with Arjun Sathe. As we understand it, the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months. The matter is listed before the Lucknow District Court.

Our advice is to issue a notice terminating the tenancy and claim mesne profits for the period of occupation. Please collect the rent agreement, the rent receipts and the notice terminating the tenancy and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹1,95,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
